title: Attestation-Aware Scheduling for Verifiable AI Placement on SEV-SNP Confidential Kubernetes Nodes — Reproducibility Artifact
description: Research artifact accompanying the working manuscript "Attestation-Aware Scheduling for Verifiable AI Placement on SEV-SNP Confidential Kubernetes Nodes". Contains the reference implementation (scheduler, central verifier, node attestation agent and offline placement-token verifier), deployment chart, experimental harnesses, archived AKS data, analysis scripts, and manuscript source/PDF. AKS data concerns node-level AMD SEV-SNP placement; kind/KWOK data is regression evidence only. The manuscript remains an anonymous review draft. The shared Go module includes auxiliary platform components outside the paper scope. See README.md and ARTIFACT_VALIDATION.md for reproduction commands, provenance and validation limitations.
